description: Add explicit external channel/thread persistence and atomic lookup so inbound and PersistMessageHistory use stamped Channels identity. Action reuse: extend Engine Conversations and existing PersistMessageHistory Action. Contract: provider/config/channel/thread/user scoped active conversations; channel-level distinct from threaded; different threads isolate; no wildcard null config; legacy rows retained but excluded; root channel post not copied into later thread; concurrency safe. Tests first for all dimensions, concurrent create, explicit ID validation, outbound path.
title: [zaq-354.2] Channel-scoped conversation persistence
